body:
This worker stopped before claiming and added the `blocked` label to `#2702`.

Two blockers prevent safe work on `#2702` now:

1. **`G-RBLv3` `U`/`V` semantics and mode words are unconfirmed.**
   - Issue `#2697` asks the reporter (`@alextreseder`) for his `XYUV` details for `G-RBLv3`, and has no reply yet.
   - Public `gedm.org` and `hackaday.io/project/190371-g-edm` pages describe `XYUV` and `XYUVZ` builds with `U`/`V` axes and linked `XU`/`YV` jogging.
   - Those public pages do not state whether `G-RBLv3` reads `U`/`V` as incremental offsets from `X`/`Y` or as independent absolute coordinates.
   - CamCraft emits upper-guide offsets in `WireU`/`WireV` (`crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs`).
   - Public pages also do not state any required taper mode word or confirmed `XYUV` dimensions (travels, guide heights, and max taper).
   - Under `#2702`, `#2697`, and the Clean-Room Protocol, workers must not read the source code of `G-RBLv3`.
   - Guessing `U`/`V` semantics risks wrong G-code output under the Prime Directive.

2. **Prerequisite `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` (`#2700`) does not exist on `upstream/main`.**
   - This worker checked `upstream/main` at `e048b103ca649e24048268e1a050f0b4686a997a`.
   - The files `assets/posts/g-edm.cps`, `assets/machines/g-edm.mch`, `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs`, and `crates/post/tests/script_g_edm.rs` do not exist.
   - Issues `#2700` (2-axis `g-edm.cps`) and `#2701` (`g-edm.mch`) are open and unclaimed, with no open PR to stack on.

This worker made no claim, branch, worktree, code change, or test run.

Remove `blocked` and resume `#2702` only after both conditions hold:
- `#2697` or public G-EDM docs confirm `G-RBLv3` `U`/`V` semantics and any required mode words.
- `#2700` merges to `main` (or opens a PR to stack on).

Still blocked: the G-RBLv3 U and V semantics (incremental or absolute, and any mode word) are not confirmed. The confirmation must come from the reporter of #2697 or from public G-EDM documents. #2697 has no reply. The other blocker #2700 is closed.
